karty.cs: to renew; to renovate, to refurbish
karty.priklad: Rhaid i fi adnewyddu fy nhrwydded yrru.
karty.priklad_cs: I must renew my driving licence (trwydded → [nh]rwydded after fy; gyrru → [y]rru after the feminine trwydded).
karty.mnemo: ad- (again) + newydd (new): to make new again.

extra.pozn: Mae'r tŷ wedi cael ei adnewyddu = the house has been renovated; own example

sever.priklad: Rhaid i mi adnewyddu fy nhrwydded yrru.
sever.priklad_cs: I must renew my driving licence (trwydded → [nh]rwydded after fy; gyrru → [y]rru after the feminine trwydded).
sever.pozn: north: i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Addawodd hi ddod yn ôl yn fuan.
karty.priklad_cs: She promised to come back soon (dod → [dd]od as the object).

extra.pozn: irregular stem: addawodd, addawais; addewid = promise (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Gawsoch chi eich cnoi gan gi erioed?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you ever been bitten by a dog? (ci → [g]i after gan; cawsoch → [g]awsoch in the question)
karty.mnemo: A dog chewing a CANOE (CNOI) paddle.

extra.pozn: stem and past tense to be checked (colloquially cnoiodd / cnôdd); passive with cael (L11); sentence from the card game, p. 188

karty.priklad: Rhaid i chi gwblhau'r cwrs cyn yr arholiad.
karty.priklad_cs: You must complete the course before the exam (cwblhau → [g]wblhau after i chi).

extra.pozn: coursebook: cwblhau = gorffen (more formal); past tense cwblhaodd; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r dŵr yn dal i lifo i mewn i'r tŷ.
karty.priklad_cs: The water is still flowing into the house (llifo → [l]ifo after i).

extra.pozn: llif (L11), gorlifo = to overflow (L11); own example

karty.priklad: Mae ei thymheredd hi'n cael ei fesur gan y nyrs.
karty.priklad_cs: Her temperature is being taken by the nurse (tymheredd → [th]ymheredd after ei = her; mesur → [f]esur after ei = its, i.e. tymheredd).

extra.pozn: mesur is also a noun = measure, measurement, bill (in parliament) (homonym); present passive with cael (p. 195); sentence from the exercise on p. 196

karty.priklad: Faint wyt ti'n bwyso?
karty.priklad_cs: How much do you weigh? (pwyso → [b]wyso after the dropped ei: Faint wyt ti'n (ei) bwyso?, compare L7)

extra.pozn: pwyso'r botwm = to press the button; pwyso ar = to lean on, to press someone; own example

karty.priklad: Gwelais i neidr hir ddu yn sleifio o dan y tŷ.
karty.priklad_cs: I saw a long black snake slinking under the house (du → [dd]u after the feminine neidr).

extra.pozn: sentence from the reading on p. 199 (narrative form gwelais i, colloquially in the south weles i)

karty.priklad: Cwympodd e a thorri ei goes.
karty.priklad_cs: He fell and broke his leg (torri → [th]orri after a; coes → [g]oes after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: WHUMP! (CWYMP-o) – and you're flat on the floor.

extra.pozn: southern counterpart of the northern syrthio from the Geirfa of L15 (De/Gogledd L14); cwympo i gysgu = to fall asleep; own example

sever.priklad: Syrthiodd o a thorri ei goes.
sever.priklad_cs: He fell and broke his leg (torri → [th]orri after a; coes → [g]oes after ei = his).
sever.pozn: north: syrthio instead of cwympo (L14, Geirfa L15), o instead of e (L1)

karty.priklad: Dw i'n mynd i'r gampfa ambell waith.
karty.priklad_cs: I go to the gym occasionally (campfa → [g]ampfa after i'r, feminine; gwaith → [w]aith after ambell).
karty.mnemo: An AMBULance only comes by AMBELL waith – once in a while.

extra.pozn: goes BEFORE a singular noun; ambell waith = sometimes, occasionally; ambell un = the odd one; own example

karty.priklad: Y dyddiau hyn, dyw cadw ci neu gath ddim yn beth anarferol o gwbl.
karty.priklad_cs: These days keeping a dog or a cat isn't unusual at all (cath → [g]ath after neu; peth → [b]eth after yn).

extra.pozn: the prefix an- = negative (anlwcus, anghofio); sentence from the reading on p. 198, which has dydy; southern dyw in the main version

sever.priklad: Y dyddiau hyn, dydy cadw ci neu gath ddim yn beth anarferol o gwbl.
sever.priklad_cs: These days keeping a dog or a cat isn't unusual at all (cath → [g]ath after neu; peth → [b]eth after yn).
sever.pozn: north: dydy instead of dyw (outside the coursebook; the reading on p. 198 has this form)

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n anlwcus – ro'n i'n dost ar ddiwrnod y gêm.
karty.priklad_cs: I was unlucky – I was ill on the day of the game (tost → [d]ost after 'n; diwrnod → [dd]iwrnod after ar).

extra.pozn: the prefix an-; lwcus = lucky (Ro'n i wedi bod yn lwcus iawn, p. 199); own example

sever.priklad: Ro'n i'n anlwcus – ro'n i'n sâl ar ddiwrnod y gêm.
sever.priklad_cs: I was unlucky – I was ill on the day of the game (diwrnod → [dd]iwrnod after ar).

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n ddiwrnod arferol yn y swyddfa.
karty.priklad_cs: It was an ordinary day in the office (diwrnod → [dd]iwrnod after 'n).

extra.pozn: fel arfer = usually; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r ffordd i'r fferm yn gul iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The road to the farm is very narrow (cul → [g]ul after yn).

extra.pozn: the opposite of llydan; meddwl cul = narrow-minded; plural outside the coursebook; example based on Robin Radio (Sut mae'r ffordd i'r fferm?, p. 200)

karty.priklad: Yn gyffredinol, mae'r gwasanaeth yn dda iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: In general, the service is very good (cyffredinol → [g]yffredinol after yn).

extra.pozn: yn gyffredinol = in general, on the whole; etholiad cyffredinol = general election; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r ganolfan gymunedol ar agor bob dydd.
karty.priklad_cs: The community centre is open every day (canolfan → [g]anolfan after y, feminine; cymunedol → [g]ymunedol after the feminine canolfan).

extra.pozn: cymuned (L4); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r teulu dieithr yn cael eu croesawu gan y gymuned.
karty.priklad_cs: The newcomer family is being welcomed by the community (literally: the strange family; cymuned → [g]ymuned after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: "Not this one, not THE OTHER (di-EITHR) – I don't know any of them": strangers.

extra.pozn: dieithryn = stranger (outside the coursebook); rhyfedd = strange, odd (L3); sentence from the exercise on p. 196

karty.priklad: Oes tasgau dyddiol gyda chi?
karty.priklad_cs: Do you have daily tasks?

extra.pozn: wythnosol = weekly, blynyddol = annual (L13); sentence from p. 194

sever.priklad_cs: Do you have daily tasks? (tasgau → [d]asgau after gynnoch chi)
sever.pozn: north: gynnoch chi instead of gyda chi (L6)

karty.priklad: Mae'r afon yn llydan iawn fan hyn.
karty.priklad_cs: The river is very wide here (ll doesn't mutate after yn).
karty.mnemo: A road as wide as a giant dustbin LID (LLYD-an).

extra.pozn: the opposite of cul; lled = width; the feminine form and the plural are outside the coursebook (rather literary); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n cael fy nhalu'n wythnosol.
karty.priklad_cs: I get paid weekly (talu → [nh]alu after fy).

extra.pozn: based on the table of the present passive, p. 195; own example

karty.cs: to keep an eye on; to keep track of
karty.priklad: Pwy sy'n cadw golwg ar y cloc?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's keeping an eye on the clock?
karty.mnemo: cadw (to keep) + golwg (look, sight): to keep your eyes on something.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; soft mutation after ar (cadw golwg ar blant); cadw trefn = to keep order, cadw'n dwym = to keep warm (p. 195); sentence from the dialogue, p. 194

karty.priklad: Oes rhywun o'r adran cynnal a chadw wedi bod yma eto?
karty.priklad_cs: Has anyone from the maintenance department been here yet? (cadw → [ch]adw after a)
karty.mnemo: A maintenance man in blue overalls on a frosty morning: cynnal (to sustain) a cadw (and to keep).

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; as a noun masculine (a pair of verb-nouns, which are masculine); sentence from the dialogue, p. 194

karty.priklad: Mae'n gas gyda fi weithio dan bwysau.
karty.priklad_cs: I hate working under pressure (gweithio → [w]eithio after gas gyda fi; pwysau → [b]wysau after dan).

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; sentence from the dialogue, p. 194

sever.priklad: Mae'n gas gen i weithio dan bwysau.
sever.priklad_cs: I hate working under pressure (gweithio → [w]eithio after gas gen i; pwysau → [b]wysau after dan).
sever.pozn: north: gen i instead of gyda fi (L6)

karty.priklad: Pryd mae'r dyddiad cau ar gyfer y swydd?
karty.priklad_cs: When is the closing date for the job?
karty.mnemo: dyddiad (date) + cau (to close): the date freezes solid and the door slams shut.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; as a noun masculine, plural dyddiadau cau (plural outside the coursebook); cyn y dyddiad cau (dialogue, p. 194); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r plant yn cael helfa drysor yn yr ardd.
karty.priklad_cs: The children are having a treasure hunt in the garden (trysor → [d]rysor after the feminine helfa).
karty.mnemo: hela (to hunt) + -fa: a hunt for a treasure chest glowing like hot coals.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; as a noun feminine (like helfa = hunt), plural helfeydd trysor (plural outside the coursebook); trysor = treasure (L19); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r ffordd i'r fferm yn hollol wastad.
karty.priklad_cs: The road to the farm is completely flat (gwastad → [w]astad after yn hollol).
karty.mnemo: gwastad = flat, level; wastad = always (L8): watch out for the two meanings.

extra.pozn: gwastad = flat, level; yn hollol = completely (L9); Robin Radio, p. 200

karty.priklad: Arhoswch o fewn clyw, rhag ofn i fi alw.
karty.priklad_cs: Stay within earshot in case I call (galw → [a]lw after i fi).

extra.pozn: o fewn (L9), clyw (trwm ei glyw, L14); Robin Radio, p. 200; own example

sever.priklad: Arhoswch o fewn clyw, rhag ofn i mi alw.
sever.priklad_cs: Stay within earshot in case I call (galw → [a]lw after i mi).
sever.pozn: north: i mi instead of i fi (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Rhaid i chi dalu ymlaen llaw.
karty.priklad_cs: You must pay in advance (talu → [d]alu after i chi).
karty.mnemo: ymlaen (forward) + llaw (hand): forward into someone's hand.

extra.pozn: Diolch ymlaen llaw = thanks in advance; also in the Geirfa of L17 (no card there); Robin Radio, p. 200; own example
